sources.dem: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (~10m), clipped to NYC. EPSG:4269, metres NAVD88.
sources.sea_level: NPCC4 (Braneon et al. 2024), NYC Open Data 38ps-fnsg. 10th/25th/75th/90th percentiles - no median is published.
sources.tides: NOAA CO-OPS station 8518750 (The Battery), 1983-2001 epoch, relative to NAVD88.
sources.exceedance: NOAA Extreme Water Levels, station 8518750, Tidal Datums and Exceedance Probability Levels, read 2026-09-01. Still-water levels from a GEV fit to annual maxima with the MSL trend removed - not FEMA base flood elevations. This product retires 2026-09-30.

tractid.encoding: index = R * 256 + G; 0 means no tract
tractid.note: feature i of tracts.json is stored as i + 1

tracts.note: population is reported at tract resolution and never allocated to individual buildings

spill.description: lowest waterline at which the cell connects to open water

buildings.layout: float32[n][5] = lon, lat, ground_m, height_m, units
buildings.units_note: UnitsRes is a lot-level figure, divided evenly among the buildings on that lot. Summing over flooded buildings therefore approximates the lot total rather than multiplying it.
buildings.note: ground_m is the footprint's own recorded ground_elevation, converted from feet - not sampled from the DEM
